neighbours.label: physical actuation of a switch-like mechanism: a trigger, button, sensor or switch turning something on or off, as against figurative triggering and switching
fire: When the door opens, a small magnet trips a switch that sounds the alarm.
The thermostat will automatically turn the heater off at 22 degrees.
Pulling the lever releases a trigger that drops the weight onto the plate.
A pressure sensor activates the pump whenever the tank runs low.
Pressing the red button cuts power to every machine on the floor.
The timer flips a relay that switches the sprinklers on at dawn.
If smoke is detected, the sensor triggers the sprinklers in that room.
Certain proteins act as switches, turning cell division on and off.
quiet: When the door opens, a cold draft blows through the whole house.
The old song will always remind her of summers at the lake.
Pulling weeds in the heat left him tired and sunburned.
A sad film always triggers memories of her grandfather.
He switched teams halfway through the season.
The timer on the oven was set for forty minutes.
If smoke is visible from the road, the farmers are burning stubble.
Certain proteins are found in eggs, beans and fish.
